Such tenders are liable for rejection, 14)Sinking of borewell should ber carried out by rig machine bearing FORM NO 7A approved by competent authority. 18)The rig shall be super fast Hydraulic rig of capacity 300 PSIG and above, 1100 CMF and below document should be uploaded, 19)Certificate to be uploaded 1Rig RC Book 2 Rig Insurance Copy 3 Rig Fitness Certificate Issued by competent authority4 Rig Compressor Capacity Certificate, 20)The tenderer can participate for any number of District tendere will be consider on the number of drilling Rigs owned by the tenderer, 21)The Contractor should abide to the safety rules and regulations issued by the Government with respect to drilling of bore wells, 22)19.
